pr_body:
It turns out these unexported fields can cause pain. As far as I can tell,
these deprecated fields haven't been needed for a whole release. I'll note
that we probably ought to more generally fix gogoproto to not try to marshal
unexported fields and we should probably disallow them, but, alas, this is
the most expedient thing for me to do here.

Fixes #86664
Fixes #86509

Release justification: Important bug fix.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/86683)

Going to leave this sit now, the branch cut was delayed by a day so hopefully this will turn green and we can hit the button later today or early tmrw.
@ajwerner going to hand this back to you if that's ok. I *think* this PR should be green but somehow it isn't. Stuff passes locally. Hopefully the slack thread will produce something illuminating.

comments: Turns out that this is actually https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/32622e1b18030bd52529841ec1bb280a5683d5cb/pkg/upgrade/upgrademanager/manager.go#L342-L355

Okay, this is the unexported fields in `roachpb.Error`:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/5a7a7bcfc2cd62698edda2e2977af4d5f34150a1/pkg/roachpb/errors.proto#L675-L684

This is a fun one. We’re seeing an upgrade test failing sometimes due to a failure to check for migration jobs which internally unmarshals job payloads which internally contain errors which internally sometimes contain roachpb.Error which has unexported fields that cause our json unmarshaling to barf. I don’t know why this just started happening now. Maybe it happened before an we didn’t notice it. 

Anyway, when it comes to fixing it, I see two approaches:
1) Remove the deprecated fields -- the commentary indicates that this is now safe
2) Export the deprecated fields 
3) Provide a custom json marshaler implementation

I'm inclined to move on 1.
Flagging @dt and @miretskiy for awareness: what are your thoughts on this?
